_comment: THE release-identity truth table (release identity design gates 1 and 7). Each row is a REAL git history built by test/helpers/release_identity_trees.ts — one commit carrying the repo's real build_info.txt placeholder, .gitattributes export-subst line and a version.ts declaring 7.0.0 (DEDALO_DATA_VERSION) and 7.0.0 (DEDALO_NEXT_RELEASE: the next release is 7.0.0 until v7.0.0 is tagged, VERSIONING_SPEC section 5), then `steps`. An UNTAGGED row names its dev identity `X.Y.Z-dev` with the NEXT triple (7.0.0-dev), never the data triple — and is judged as a CHECKOUT and as a `git archive`-EXTRACTED tree by every resolver: the engine's (test/unit/release_identity_native.test.ts) and the shell twin deploy/dedalo-image-lib.sh dedalo_release_identity (test/unit/release_identity_shell_parity.test.ts). A step is {tag, annotated, date?} or {commit: true}. `notice` is a regular expression the ENGINE's notice must match (null = no notice); the shell twin prints the identity only.

rows.name: a lightweight tag only (describe ignores it — release tags are annotated, Q7)
a code-only patch tag above the data triple (v7.0.1 over data 7.0.0)
a tag BELOW the data triple (v6.9.0 over data 7.0.0)
a release tag AND a newer non-release annotated tag on the same commit
